object:crude dagger / orcish dagger.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a short rough dark gray blade attached to a reddish-brown grip. The blue-gray patterned floor is background, not part of the object.
object:crude dagger / orcish dagger.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies the orcish dagger as an orcish dagger usable in melee or thrown. Its visible name in this tile is crude dagger; the atlas association alone does not make the appearance a second weapon.
